body:
S251-09: itemdef.Registry.ByName now normalizes multi-word names (spaces->hyphens) on both stored and lookup sides -- no multi-word item was ever reachable by its real hyphenated shop id before. S251-10: eat command's dispatch now reads args[0] (was args[1]), matching the adjacent use command's own correct pattern -- single-word 'eat potion' always missed before. S251-11: Leather Gloves/Spiked Knuckles' equip_slots corrected from handl/handr to the real canonical hand-l/hand-r -- neither was ever equippable as authored. New test TestByName_HyphenatedMultiWordName. go build/test ./... clean. Live-verified: zero active player connections confirmed first, rebuilt+restarted the real gfd-mud.service, confirmed listening cleanly. Commit fa8b62d.

⚓ ☃
title: S251-09/10/11: three real found-live item-system bugs fixed
